sources.title: Business report to video in n8n: your monthly numbers, explained by Claude in 2 minutes (free n8n workflow template)
sources.text: Hey n8n community, if you send your team, your investors or your clients a review deck every month, here’s a free n8n workflow template for business review videos: your report in, a narrated 2 to 4
taskExcerpts: Hey n8n community, if you send your team, your investors or your clients a review deck every month, here’s a free n8n workflow template for business review videos: your report in, a narrated 2 to 4

spans.text: Hey n8n community, if you send your team, your investors or your clients a review deck every month, here’s a free n8n workflow template for business review videos: your report in, a narrated 2 to 4

Import the workflow from the gallery link above, or open a new workflow, click ⋯ → Import from File and pick the attached report-summary-videos.json. Add your Shotstack API key to Make the video and Check the render. You can start a free trial here: Shotstack - The Cloud Video Editing API Add an API key for your AI model to the Claude steps. Claude Opus 5.5 is the model I’ve had the most success with. Fill in Your report: the file name, your company name, your brand colours and who’s watching (the team, the board, clients). Put your file in a reports folder in n8n’s files folder. In Docker, mount a folder from your computer there, for example -v ./n8n-files:/home/node/.n8n-files. On an npm install the folder is .n8n-files in your home folder. Click Execute workflow. A video takes about 15 minutes. What it costs and how long it takes
About 15 minutes: Claude writes the edit in about 4, and the voice and render take about 10

sources.title: Can n8n be integrated with MirrorFly Instant Messaging Software?
sources.text: I want to check the possibility of integrating MirrorFly with n8n and understand how the platforms could work.
taskExcerpts: I want to check the possibility of integrating MirrorFly with n8n and understand how the platforms could work.

spans.text: I want to check the possibility of integrating MirrorFly with n8n and understand how the platforms could work. MirrorFly, a complete communication software solution that includes instant messaging, one-to-one and group chats, voice and video calls, group calling, and more. Businesses can purchase a complete software package. I am interested in exploring how n8n could connect with MirrorFly to automate workflows and integrate communication features with other business applications. For example, this could include automating notifications, connecting with CRM systems, or triggering workflows based on specific events. Has anyone integrated MirrorFly or a similar communication software solution with n8n using APIs or webhooks? I’d appreciate any suggestions on the feasibility of this integration and the best way to get started.

sources.title: Store owners: what’s the best way for app developers to learn from you?
sources.text: I’m developing a Shopify app to address a merchant problem, and one of the hardest parts has been finding store owners to talk to.
taskExcerpts: I’m developing a Shopify app to address a merchant problem, and one of the hardest parts has been finding store owners to talk to.

spans.text: I’m developing a Shopify app to address a merchant problem, and one of the hardest parts has been finding store owners to talk to. Most responses to my posts so far have come from Partners and developers. I appreciate those conversations, but I’m missing the perspective of the people I’m actually building for. Building without those conversations feels like walking down a dark, winding road: I can keep moving, but it’s hard to know whether I’m heading in the right direction. If you run a store, what would make you comfortable sharing your experience with an app developer? And if you’re a developer, how did you find your first few merchants to learn from? I’m looking to understand how merchants work and where they struggle. Even a short exchange here would help.

sources.title: Feature request: Product-specific customer tax exemptions for accurate wholesale and retail checkout
sources.text: Calculate the correct tax amounts before payment, without requiring draft orders, manual adjustments or additional invoices.
taskExcerpts: Calculate the correct tax amounts before payment, without requiring draft orders, manual adjustments or additional invoices.

spans.text: Calculate the correct tax amounts before payment, without requiring draft orders, manual adjustments or additional invoices.
Record actual GST and PST amounts accurately in Shopify’s order records and tax reports.

The goal is not to create an alternative tax calculation system. It is to make Shopify’s existing customer exemption functionality more precise and compatible with businesses serving different types of customers and transactions.
The suggested workarounds involve creating draft orders, manually changing customer exemptions or asking wholesale customers to use separate accounts for retail purchases.

spans.text: Make.com Automation for Simple Business Tasks Hi! I’m learning and building practical automations with Make.com , and I’m available to help with small, clearly defined automation tasks. What I can help with: - Connecting Google Forms to Google Sheets - Sending automatic Gmail notifications - Organizing simple workflows using Make filters and routers - Setting up basic customer email workflows - Helping test and troubleshoot simple scenarios I have built a practice workflow using Google Forms, Google Sheets, Gmail, and Gemini for customer support and request classification. I’m interested in starting with small projects, with a clear scope and agreed requirements. If you need help with a simple Make automation, please describe your workflow and what you want to automate.
